#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""harness — the engine CLI entry point; a thin dispatcher over engine.cli.

The portability boundary: CI and other agent frameworks call this with zero
plugin involvement. Exit 0 = verdict/result emitted (semantics live in the
JSON); exit 2 = malformed input; exit 1 = check failed / engine error.

The subcommands themselves live in `engine/cli/`, one module per command
family; this file exists only to put the plugin root on `sys.path` so those
imports resolve when the script is invoked from a consumer repo.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

PLUGIN_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(PLUGIN_ROOT))

from engine.cli import main                                    # noqa: E402

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
